Company Description:

Job Description:

We’re looking for a seasoned Accounts Payable Administrator to join our busy Finance team on a six-month fixed-term contract. 

This hands-on role will see you personally processing high volumes of invoices and credit notes, typically around 1,000 invoices per month, completing reconciliations, resolving queries and supporting the team to meet processing deadlines. Please click here to view position description.

You’re an experienced Accounts Payable professional who is comfortable working at pace and managing high volumes without compromising accuracy. You take a practical approach to manual processes and system challenges and communicate confidently with suppliers and internal teams. 

You’ll bring: 

  • At least two to three years’ Accounts Payable experience 
  • Proven experience processing around 1,000 invoices per month 
  • Strong accuracy, attention to detail and reconciliation skills 
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a busy environment 
  • Clear and professional communication skills 
  • Experience with TechnologyOne or a similar finance system would be advantageous

You can help bring our villages to life! 

At Summerset, from the moment we start developing a village, to when our residents call it home, it’s the passion and dedication of our people that brings our villages to life. We are one team united by being part of something bigger – to bring the best of life to our residents.

As a Caregiver at our Casebrook village you will work as part of a team that creates the safest, healthiest and most enjoyable lifestyle for our residents. This role is varied and centres around providing personal care and assistance to our resident’s daily lives.

Typical duties include:

  • Delivering meals and helping with mealtimes
  • Aiding with hygiene, such as showering
  • Assisting with Individual care plan requirements, such as walks and exercises
  • Helping with activities, such as puzzles, table tennis etc

We have a range of permanent part-time positions with fixed, predictable rosters, including:

  • Tuesday to Saturday, 4:00pm to 8:00pm (20 hours per week)
  • Sunday to Tuesday, 7:00am to 3:00pm, plus Wednesday and Thursday, 8:00am to 1:00pm (33.5 hours per week)
  • Saturday, 7:00am to 3:00pm, Sunday, 8:00am to 1:00pm, and Monday, 8:00am to 1:30pm (17 hours per week)
  • Tuesday and Wednesday, 3:00pm to 11:00pm, Friday, 4:00pm to 9:30pm, and Saturday, 4:30pm to 10:00pm (25.5 hours per week)
  • Thursday to Saturday, 7:00am to 3:00pm (22.5 hours per week)

Fixed-Term Opportunity (until 17 February 2027)

  • Tuesday to Saturday, 7:00am to 1:00pm (27.5 hours per week)

Please click here to view the full job description.  

Qualifications:

You will naturally be empathetic, kind and patient, and thrive in a role where your compassion and care make a difference to people’s lives.

You’ll bring with you:

  • Experience in aged care or a similar role
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to build lasting relationships
  • Commitment to a consistent part-time roster with set days and hours.

At Summerset, we believe diversity strengthens our team and enriches the care we provide. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and walks of life.

Additional Information:

Summerset's known for its excellent benefits and strong sense of values around care, teamwork and drive for excellence. With some of the best benefits in the sector, some of these include:

  • Opportunities to progress your caregiver career and gain further qualifications
  • Southern Cross Health Essentials Insurance (not applicable to fixed-term position)

job.description:
Company Description:

You can help bring our villages to life!

At Summerset, from the moment we start developing a village to when our residents call it home, it’s the passion and dedication of our people that brings our villages to life. We are one team, united by being part of something bigger – bringing the best of life to our residents.

Job Description:

We’re on the lookout for an inspirational and experienced Care Centre Manager to lead our team at Summerset Papamoa. You’ll play a critical role in building a high-performing team of Nurses and Caregivers, and ensure we continue to deliver the exceptional care we’re known for.

What you’ll be doing:

Reporting to the Village Manager, you’ll be responsible for the care centre’s daily operations and strategic leadership, including:

  • Full accountability for staffing, budgeting, and compliance
  • Leading and coaching your team with a strong focus on recruitment, development, and recognition
  • Building meaningful relationships with residents, their families, and stakeholders – and being their trusted point of contact, especially in sensitive situations
  • Supporting sound clinical decision-making and ensuring quality care at all times
  • Managing audits, policy implementation, and working with NASC, Te Whatu Ora and other key external agencies
  • Driving a strong, connected team culture across the village

This is a full-time position, Monday to Friday, 8am – 5pm, with some occasional on-call responsibilities that include weekends and nights.

Please click here to view the full job description.

Qualifications:

You’ll bring experience in a clinical environment with a deep understanding of the aged care sector and Te Whatu Ora standards. You’ll be an experienced manager with solid aged care experience in New Zealand, ready for a new challenge, you’ll be passionate about leading people, driving quality outcomes, and making a real difference.

You’re someone who leads with empathy, builds trust, and can bring out the best in others. You’re confident balancing people leadership with operational management, and thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

At Summerset, we believe diversity strengthens our team and enriches the care we provide. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and walks of life.

Additional Information:

Why Summerset?

When you join Summerset, you’re joining a team that values you – your contribution, your growth, and your wellbeing.  

For a passionate leader this will be the exciting challenge you crave. You'll get excellent remuneration, the support of a friendly team, and all the satisfaction of making a real difference in people's lives.

Summerset's known for its excellent benefits and strong sense of values around care, teamwork and drive for excellence. With some of the best benefits in the sector, some of these include:

  • Free Southern Cross Wellbeing Insurance
  • Free Southern Cross Health Insurance (covering up to 75% of charges for GPs, dentists, physios and more)
  • Birthday leave, so you can take your special day off on us
  • Opportunities to grow your career in one of NZ’s fastest-growing aged care providers

If this sounds like you then please apply today. Applications close on 27th October.
